description: A shell script for device-specific upgrade procedures for Buffalo devices with MT7622 chipset, including image validation, upgrade logic, and device-specific parameters.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for compatibility and correctness based on device-specific parameters and image format.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs an upgrade using a TRX + UBI formatted image, including erasing the flash and writing the new image.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that selects between UBINIZED and NAND upgrade procedures based on image magic.
